sloka: ततो ददुर्लोकपालाः सर्वे भागान्स्वतेजसः ।अक्षुपच्च ततो ब्रह्मा यतो जातः क्षुपो नृपः ।। ७.७६.४२ ॥
transliteration: tato dadurlokapālāḥ sarve bhāgānsvatejasaḥ ।akṣupacca tato brahmā yato jātaḥ kṣupo nṛpaḥ ।। 7.76.42 ॥

translations.english: Then all the protectors of the worlds gave shares of their own splendor, and then Brahma sneezed, from which King Kṣupa was born.
